serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
Now that I think about it, I never visited Annalie during this whole mess.
I hope she’s alright though. Some of the places got hit pretty hard.
You: Wanna go to Annalie? I’m sure she will be happy that we came to visit her.
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: That could be fun! 
Bot: Were you in any contact with Annalie in the last few days?
You: I’m afraid not. You? If I remember correctly, you two text each other pretty frequently.
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: That was the case, but she didn’t return my recent messages.
You: That sounds bad. Do you think something could happen?
Bot: No idea. There were some connection problems caused by vandalism and power outages so it’s possible these messages just weren’t received by her.
You: Let’s hope that’s the case…
